summary.text: Osman Salahuddin is a Democratic member of the Washington House of Representatives from District 48-Position 1, where he has served since January 2025, and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot seeking re-election.
He is a former Redmond City Councilmember and cancer researcher.

paragraphs.text: Osman Salahuddin is a Redmond native and, according to the House Democrats' biography, the son of immigrants, a special education teacher and a small business owner.
He earned a B.S. in neurobiology from the University of Washington, where he served as Student Body President.
Before being elected, he worked as a researcher at Fred Hutch Cancer Research Center and UW Medicine.
Salahuddin served on the Redmond City Council, worked for the King County Council and contributed to non-profit boards including the Transportation Choices Coalition.
He took office in the House on January 7, 2025, succeeding Vandana Slatter.
